data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the NATS broker.
data_description.password: The password for authenticating with the NATS broker.
data_description.port: The port number of the NATS broker (default: 4222).
data_description.username: The username for authenticating with the NATS broker.

not_loaded.message: The NATS integration is not loaded

entry_required.message: Several NATS entries are loaded; set config_entry_id

entry_not_found.message: No loaded NATS entry with that config_entry_id

publish.name: Publish
publish.description: Publishes a message to a NATS subject, optionally through JetStream, which returns the stream, sequence number and duplicate flag.

subject.name: Subject
subject.description: The NATS subject to publish to.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Message body. A string is sent as-is; anything else is sent as JSON.

headers.name: Headers
headers.description: Optional message headers, such as Nats-Msg-Id for de-duplication.

jetstream.name: JetStream
jetstream.description: Publish through JetStream and wait for the stream's acknowledgement. Fails if no stream captures the subject.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The NATS entry to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.

fetch.name: Fetch
fetch.description: Pulls up to a batch of messages from an existing durable JetStream pull consumer and returns them. Returns at once when nothing is pending.

consumer.name: Consumer
consumer.description: The name of an existing durable pull consumer on the stream.

batch.name: Batch size
batch.description: The maximum number of messages to fetch (1-100).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the broker to deliver the batch, in seconds.

ack.name: Acknowledge
ack.description: Acknowledge the messages so they are not redelivered. Turn off to peek; unacknowledged messages come back after the consumer's ack wait.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The NATS entry to use. Only needed when more than one is set up.
